divergences.title: Verity legacy pre-family-1.2 profile lacks packet-local family tuple/lock
divergences.disposition: Use exact repo/commit/packet digests and deny family-schema conformance claims; future Verity migration remains owner-scoped.

divergences.title: Packet-specific capability manifests do not conform to one family manifest schema
divergences.disposition: Keep packet-specific profiles; do not advertise family manifest conformance.

divergences.title: Relative schema IDs collide when stripped of repository context
divergences.disposition: Qualify by repository+commit+packet path+schema path+digest; prohibit cross-packet bare-$id registries.

divergences.title: Native result references require consumer-owned enrichment before import
divergences.disposition: Resolve immutable bundle, verify it, then create a consumer-owned imported-result transformation; compatibility stays unknown until implemented.

divergences.title: Permission and evidence vocabularies differ
divergences.disposition: Use explicit profile mapping only in a consumer; never silently alias or widen authority.

divergences.title: Packet writer/readiness/runtime mechanisms differ
divergences.disposition: Treat as repository-specific tooling; no common writer/runtime contract is claimed.

divergences.title: Completion payload refinements differ
divergences.disposition: Preserve capability-specific coverage/details while retaining common truthful top-level states.

prohibited_conclusions: No compatibility is implemented or proven.
